hypothesis: Intercalation compounds can be used as electrodes in rechargeable lithium batteries
prediction: A lithium battery using LiCoO2 as the cathode and graphite as the anode will have a higher cycle life than a lithium metal battery
measurement_method: Charge-discharge cycling tests with non-aqueous electrolyte
falsification_condition: If the cycle life of the LiCoO2-graphite battery is less than 20 cycles, or if dendrite formation is observed on the anode, the prediction is falsified
